Name: Quality
Description: fast, standard or high. High renders at double resolution for sharper textures.

Name: Lighting
Description: auto, ldr, hdr or both. Auto builds whatever lighting the map has.

Name: Game Rules
Description: gmod or hl2. Chosen from the game by default. Only gmod reads the game's mounted content from cfg/mount.cfg.

Name: Extra Content
Description: Adds a content folder or archive that the game does not load by itself.

Name: Graphics Card
Description: Uses the graphics card whose name contains this word, such as 3050.

Name: Strict
Description: Stops the compile at the first thing SourceCubemap can't reproduce exactly, instead of using the closest match.
Warning: Many maps need the default behaviour to finish.

Name: Command Line Argument
Description: Passes value as a command line argument
